verdict.rationale: Pomelo is an API-first card-issuing platform, so its endpoints are a headless, programmatic interface. It also documents a separate Stage API environment alongside production that automated pipelines could target. It does not document CI usage, a CLI, or headless test tooling: the transaction simulator runs through a dashboard UI, and Stage access is provisioned through the integration team rather than self-serve. missing for 10: documented CI/automation guidance, an official CLI or headless runner, self-serve test credentials, a programmatic (non-UI) simulator, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
